title: Guildco
metaTitle: Guildco Brand Identity & Website — Case Study | Santi Universe
description: Guildco brand identity and website: a bold wordmark, a structured colour system, business cards, company profiles and a connected digital presence.

chapters.label: The identity
heading: A strong name.
A clear presence.
text: Guildco operates across construction, property development and mining services. The identity gives that broad offering a consistent visual presence, from a first introduction to a detailed company profile.
A bold wordmark anchors the system. A compact band of colour and oversized outline forms add recognition without competing with the company name.

chapters.label: The system
heading: Structure, with
character.
text: The starter guide pairs the Montserrat family with near-black, forest green, teal, earthy brown and a light neutral. These elements give the brand a practical vocabulary for headings, page structure and graphic accents.
Vertical colour bands and outline letterforms connect the materials while allowing photography and content to take the lead.

images.alt: Guildco starter brand guide showing Montserrat, colours and graphic elements
images.caption: Starter brand guide

chapters.label: In print
heading: Small details.
A lasting impression.
text: The business-card artwork carries the same wordmark, narrow colour band and large outline motif into a compact format. The restrained front places the brand first.

images.alt: Guildco business card front with bold wordmark, colour stripe and fine outline artwork
images.caption: Business card · front artwork

chapters.label: Company profiles
heading: One identity.
A broader story.
text: The supplied profiles show how the system extends across construction and mining communications. Large industrial photographs introduce each document, while clear headings and consistent accents organise the service information.
The later mining profile uses colour panels and modular layouts to make a more detailed offering easier to navigate.

chapters.label: The website
heading: The brand,
working online.
text: The live website brings the identity into a digital setting, combining the white wordmark and dark navigation with construction imagery and green and teal accents.
Dedicated routes to Construction and Mining Services help visitors find the relevant offering, alongside company information and contact details.
